notes.title: Update 1.2.0 Christmas!
notes.content:
Hi! I hope you guys enjoyed the game!
I had to do an update to solve some bugs and small things I got feedback on.
Merry Christmas and Happy New Year!!

Here are the update patches:
-Added french, german and russian languages
-Added controller rumble
-Added option to deactivate eletric effect of the guitar
-Added christmas event
-Fixed small bugs
-Changed Marisa's costume to generic witch due to copyright issues

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45022502/d45fc0109ee20323ae3261764c2936a768280aa6.png[/img]

notes.title: Update 1.1 LEADERBOARDS!!!
notes.content:
For some reason I added score but not a leaderboard nor achievements based on scores...

Update 1.1:
-Hopefully fixed sliding
-Added option to deactivate the CC Post Processing (the one that makes the game "blurry")
-Added score leaderboard

To upload your score, open the game and it should do it. You can see your score in a gameover screen. Keep in mind there might be hacked scores in the future. If you are one of them, please don't. Enjoy the game!!

notes.title: Update 1.0.3
notes.content:
Update 1.0.3:
-Fixed sliding for the most part
-Changed the requirements to unlock Biker from finishing level 16 to level 12
-Added keyboard and controller rebinding
-Made the firesword hitbox bigger

After this I'll add an option to deactivate the post processing that some people don't like.
I don't plan on any updates after that (if no more bugs are found), at best I'll add one or two collab characters.

notes.title: Update 1.0.2
notes.content:
In this new small update I just wanted to fix some essential bugs and problems:
-Added the collision at the end of level 3
-Fixed some translation errors
-Added highscore at the start, in the main menu
-Player no longer sticks to the wall
-Fixed some UI bugs

Im working on controller binding too, its going to take a while so I decided to launch this update before I launch the controller binding

notes.title: Update 1.0.1
notes.content:
This is the first update but it's something fast. I've been hearing to all the feedback from you so I'm going to implement some updates in the next days. Right now it's just a fast one, there were some bugging me.
1.0.1 patch updates:
-Changed the requirements of the nurse outfit to finish level 8 in 15 minutes instead of 12
-Solved a bug with the nurse outfit unlocking
-Changed the requirements of the nurse outfit to finish level 4 in 5 minutes instead of 4
-Zoom out the camera of the player, field of view is now bigger
-Gorilla no longer grabs you in the air, it wasn't supposed to be like this anyway
-Solved a bug with gorilla effects

There will be more bug fixes in the future and some features I want to add such as:
-Controller binding
-More resolutions other than 16:9
-Some hitboxes problems
-Air control bugs
-Score in the main menu
-Some more problems I've noticed
Please have patience while more bugs are being solved. If you find anything new, please send an e-mail to contact@maidswithguns.com

Thank you.
